questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the LTC scheme for newly recruited Central Government employees:
I. The newly recruited employee can carry forward an unavailed LTC to the next year.
II. The special scheme is optional, and the employee can choose to be governed by normal rules.
III. Spouses who are both new recruits can avail the scheme separately.
IV. After 8 years, the employee automatically transitions to the normal block year system.

options_english: I, II, and III only
II, III, and IV only
I, III, and IV only
I, II, III, and IV
questions.explanation_english: Under the special scheme for new recruits, the scheme is optional, allowing employees to choose standard rules instead. Spouses who are both new recruits can avail benefits separately, and employees automatically transition to the normal four-year block system after completing eight years. However, unavailed concessions under this yearly scheme cannot be carried forward.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। नए भर्ती हुए कर्मचारियों के लिए विशेष योजना वैकल्पिक है, जिससे कर्मचारी सामान्य नियमों का चयन कर सकते हैं। यदि दोनों पति-पत्नी नए भर्ती हुए हैं, तो वे अलग-अलग लाभ उठा सकते हैं। 8 वर्षों के बाद, कर्मचारी सामान्य चार वर्षीय ब्लॉक प्रणाली में स्वचालित रूप से स्थानांतरित हो जाते हैं। हालांकि, इस वार्षिक योजना के तहत अव्यवहृत लाभों को आगे नहीं बढ़ाया जा सकता।

Spouses can avail benefits separately.
Employees transition to normal block system after 8 years.

questions.question_english: A Line-Item Budget is best defined as a budget that:
options_english: Classifies proposed expenditures based on the overall long-term performance targets and learning outcomes of the school
Lists individual objects of expenditure such as salaries, travel, and supplies separately
Allocates financial funds dynamically based on comprehensive zero-based justifications and reviews every year

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is 'Classifies proposed expenditures based on the overall long-term performance targets and learning outcomes of the school'. It helps in ensuring that funds are allocated according to specific needs and performance metrics, thus enhancing financial management within educational institutions.
